fact: The Central Bank of Liberia's Executive Governor said PAPSS was officially launched in Liberia on 27 March 2025.
The Executive Governor said cross-border transactions grew 17.7% in 2024 to $494.5 million, and PAPSS transactions reached about L$37.7 million between June and December 2024.

BnB Liberia and Orange Money Liberia launched a service letting Orange Money wallet users in Liberia send money instantly to Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea, Cote d Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Uganda and Rwanda.
BnB and Lonestar Cell MTN MoMo launched outbound mobile money transfers from Liberia to Ivory Coast, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea, Uganda, Rwanda, Mali and Senegal, capped at US$250 per transaction.
